test_title: PYST 53: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can replace the underlined phrase and make the sentence grammatically correct.

The programme on TV __was now shown the blurring faces of the inmates of the rehabilitation centre.__

options.text: were now showing the blurred faces of the inmates of the rehabilitation centre.
was now showing the blurred faces of the inmates of the rehabilitation centre
were now showing the blurring faces of the inmates from the rehabilitation centre
was now showing the blurred faces of the inmates upon the rehabilitation centre

solution:
The correct answer is 2 i.e.this part of the sentence needs to be substituted.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct phrase should be "was now showing the blurred faces of the inmates of the rehabilitation centre".
 
• The verb "was" must be used instead of "were" to match the singular noun "programme".
 
• The past participle "blurred" correctly describes the state of the faces being shown.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *The programme on TV **was now showing the blurred faces of the inmates of the rehabilitation centre.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The verb and subject must agree in number: "programme" is singular, so it requires "was".
 
• "Blurred" is the correct form to describe the state resulting from the action of blurring.
